prompt:
CONTEXT
  Repo root: C:\path\to\project
  Your slice: everything under src\combat\
  Read those files first. Do not go outside your slice.

TASK
  Find every place where damage is applied to a target without a null check on that target.

ACCEPTANCE
  For each finding: the repo-relative file path, the 1-based line number, and the exact
  expression copied character-for-character from the file. Line numbers and exact source
  text cannot be guessed - they are the evidence that you actually read the code.

OUTPUT
  Match the required JSON schema.

CONSTRAINTS
  Do not modify any file. Do not run any command.
  If something is ambiguous, state the ambiguity in a finding's expression field and pick
  the most conservative reading - you cannot ask questions.

CONTEXT
  Repo root: C:\path\to\project
  Your slice: everything under src\net\
  Read those files first. Do not go outside your slice.

TASK
  Find every catch block that swallows an error without logging it or rethrowing.

ACCEPTANCE
  For each finding: the repo-relative file path, the 1-based line number of the catch, and
  the exact body of the catch block copied character-for-character.

OUTPUT
  Match the required JSON schema.

CONSTRAINTS
  Do not modify any file. Do not run any command.
  If something is ambiguous, state it and pick the most conservative reading - you cannot
  ask questions.
